morning_brief._comment_calendar_hours_ahead: How far ahead the brief's Calendar section looks, in hours. Omitted, zero, or non-numeric falls back to 48.

learnings._comment: What the daily learnings reviews ignore. Scoped to those tasks only — fetch_chrome_history and the calendar tools still return this data, so chat can answer questions about it.
learnings._comment_keywords: Case-insensitive substrings. A calendar event whose summary matches is dropped; so is a browsed site whose title matches, and any single page path that matches.
learnings._comment_domains: Matched on the domain and its subdomains, so 'sharepoint.com' covers 'tenant.sharepoint.com'. The second group is click-through redirectors: they contribute a duplicate row for an article already listed under its real domain, and their URL paths carry query-string junk that matches on meaningless tokens (a 'utm_source' parameter matched a wiki summary saying 'open-source'). Subdomain-scoped where the parent domain is real content — 'link.skool.com' is a redirector, 'www.skool.com' is not.
